## Requirements

### Ubiquitous
- *R01*: The system shall display the total number of participants represented in the selected dataset.
- *R02*: The system shall display an interactive histogram of daily step counts.
- *R03*: The system shall display average hourly calorie expenditure using an interactive line chart.
### Event-driven
- *R04*: WHEN a user selects a participant, the system shall update the activity visualisations to display that participant's records.
- *R05*: WHEN a user changes the date range, the system shall update all activity visualisations to reflect the selected period.
- *R06*: WHEN a user hovers over a data point, the system shall display its associated date or time and available activity measurements.
### Error handling
- *R07*: IF no records match the selected filters, THEN the system shall display a message indicating that no matching data is available.
- *R08*: IF a measurement required for a calculation is missing, THEN the system shall exclude that measurement from the calculation and report the number of excluded records.
### State-driven
- *R09*: WHILE a participant filter is active, the system shall apply the selected participant consistently across all activity visualisations.
### Optional 
- *R10*: WHERE data export is enabled, the system shall provide an option to download the filtered observations as a CSV file.

## Proposed visualisations(filterable  by person/Id).
- Histogram of daily steps
- Scatter graph plotting steps against calories if these two datasets are joined
- Steps by day - This will be a bit pointless though because it is only two days 
- Average calories per hour
